personality_one_liner: A friendly, rewarding, and gamified experience that turns eco-conscious actions into tangible fintech rewards.

spacing.rule: Use generous tactile padding. Cards must never sit flush to the screen edge; always use md or lg outer margins. Ensure touch targets are at least 44x44pt.

do's: Use glass for the bottom tab bar where content scrolls behind.
Use glass for floating action buttons or sticky bottom CTAs.
Use a frosted overlay for text placed over the hero background image.
dont's: Do not apply glass to metric cards or standard list rows.
Do not use glass if the device is a low-end Android (fallback to solid surfaceSecondary).

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Dashboard showing metrics, goals, and quick actions, with a prominent hero banner and theme selector.

states.empty: No data yet. Show a friendly prompt to 'Scan your first item!'
states.error: Failed to load dashboard. Provide a 'Retry' button.

screens.layout: Top Header: Logo, Wallet Balance chip (₹), Theme Toggle (Green/Blue/Dark/Pastel swatches). Hero Banner: Rounded card with gradient background, 'Turn Your Waste into Rewards 🌱', Upload Waste CTA, and carousel dots. Section: 'How it works' 3 numbered steps with arrows. Section: 3 Metric cards (Total kg, ₹, CO2) in a wrapping flex layout. Section: Monthly Goal progress bar. Bottom Nav: Home, Upload, Rewards, Recycler, Profile.

screens.name: Upload Scan
screens.purpose: Entry point for AI waste scanning via Camera or Gallery.

states.error: Camera permission denied error with button to open settings.

screens.layout: Pre-flight instructions on top. Two large tactile cards filling horizontal space: 'Take Photo' (Camera icon) and 'Choose from Gallery' (Image icon). Keep layout airy.

screens.name: Analysis Result
screens.purpose: AI preview and detailed breakdown of scanned waste.

states.loading: Skeleton UI over the analysis rows, pulsing 'Analyzing waste...'
states.error: Image not recognized. 'Please retake photo' CTA.

screens.layout: Top: Thumbnail of scanned item. Middle: Status badge ('Recyclable'), Detected Material tag, Quantity/Weight input row, Estimated ₹ Value row. Bottom: Sticky 'Add to Wallet (Pending)' CTA pinned to the bottom over a glassmorphism base.

screens.name: Find Recycler
screens.purpose: Map visual and nearby recycler list.

states.empty: No recyclers found nearby. 'Adjust radius' CTA.

screens.layout: Top half: Map-like visual. Bottom half: Scrollable list of Recycler cards showing name, rating, and distance. Cards have a 'Schedule Pickup' CTA.

screens.name: Schedule Pickup
screens.purpose: Date and time selection for pickup.
screens.layout: Top: Summary of selected recycler. Middle: Horizontal scroll view for Date chips, followed by Time-slot chips. Bottom: Sticky 'Confirm Pickup' CTA.

screens.name: Pickup QR & Verify
screens.purpose: Generates and simulates scanning of pickup QR.
screens.layout: Center: Large QR code in a rounded white card. Below: Pickup ID text and 'Download QR' text link. Bottom: 'Simulate Recycler Scan' button (for demo mode).

screens.name: Rewards Credited
screens.layout: Full screen success state. Animated confetti. Large success checkmark. Bold total ₹ earned. Breakdown list showing Base Value and Platform Commission. 'Back to Home' primary CTA.

screens.name: Wallet

states.empty: Empty wallet illustration. 'Start recycling to earn' CTA.

screens.layout: Top: Large Hero Green gradient Balance card. Middle: Row with 'Pending' and 'Total Earned' summary tiles. Bottom: List of recent transactions with amount, date, and +/- indicators.

screens.name: Activity
screens.purpose: History of recent scans and their status.

states.empty: Empty cardboard box illustration. 'No recent scans' CTA.

screens.layout: Top: Filter chip row (All, Analyzed, Pending, Pickup). Body: List rows of scans, each showing a thumbnail, date, name, and colored Status Badge mapped to our defined status_badges.

screens.name: Profile
screens.layout: Top: User Avatar (initials or Google photo) + Name/Email. Body: Menu rows with icons (Settings, Notifications, Theme Selector, Recycler Demo View toggle). Bottom: Logout button.

hero_nature.alt: Green leaf representing sustainability for hero card background

empty_wallet.alt: Empty wallet symbolizing no transactions yet

empty_recent_scans.alt: Recycling area filled with cardboard for empty states

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: The app must support 4 dynamic themes (Green, Blue, Dark, Pastel). Implement a React Context or Zustand store that holds the active theme and provides the tokens mapped in `theme_palettes`. Default is Green.

CRITICAL: All 4 themes must map to semantic keys (`background`, `surface`, `card`, `primary`, `secondary`, `textPrimary`, `textSecondary`, `border`, `navigationSelected`, `navigationUnselected`, `gradientHero`) so components can automatically adapt when the theme switches.

For the Dark theme, ensure text contrast is strictly maintained by using `textPrimary: #F8FAFC` against `background: #121212` and `surface: #1E293B`. Do not use pure black for cards to prevent harsh contrast fatigue.
Apply the `status_badges` color mapping strictly to the Status Badges in the Recent Scans list and Analysis Results. Render them as small pills with `bg` background and `text` color.
Use Phosphor icons consistently. Ensure empty states use oversized (48pt) Phosphor icons if the provided images don't perfectly fit the layout.

For the 'Turn Your Waste into Rewards' Hero Banner, apply a vertical gradient using the active theme's `gradientHero` tokens over the card, optionally overlaying the `hero_nature` image with a dark scrim to ensure white text readability.

Implement sticky CTAs (like 'Confirm Pickup' or 'Add to Wallet') inside a KeyboardAvoidingView with a bottom safe area and a top fade-shadow or glass effect, so they remain accessible regardless of scroll position.
Include subtle haptics on theme toggle and primary actions.
Add the 'Simulate Recycler Scan' button purely as a demo mechanic to advance the QR verification state to the Reward Credited screen.
